title: Hidden evaluation run during the Q course

tellings.quote: it was an evaluation for another unit in the military above you know these units

plain: A former Special Forces soldier named Randy Anderson says the Q course, the US Army's qualifying course for Special Forces soldiers, had a hidden evaluation running inside it. He tells Michels, as someone who went through it, that "it was an evaluation for another unit in the military above you know these units." If true, it would mean a more secret unit quietly picks its people from among Special Forces candidates.
